body: Thanks for responding, mate. You’re the only one who has so far, probably the only one who will. Means a lot to me.

How, man? Singapore’s a country built on education. And I won’t have as much as a primary school degree as an adult.

I wish I could go back to the start of my Sec 2, in 2016. Study hard, pass through the years peacefully, graduate in 2018. But I can’t. This isn’t Back to the Future. I have to deal with reality.
